sourceTitle: The Romantic Scottish Ballads: Their Epoch and Authorship
description: "The Romantic Scottish Ballads: Their Epoch and Authorship" by Robert Chambers is a scholarly analysis and historical inquiry into the traditional ballad literature of Scotland. Written during the mid-19th century, the book falls into the category of literary criticism and analysis, examining the origins and authorship of these romantic ballads that capture the cultural and social essence of Scotland.
